item.title: Flower Of Life Belt
item.description: Black Flower of Life laser engraved leather belt with silver buckle. A high quality leather belt featuring an intricate Flower of Life pattern, flowing continuously around the entire belt. Overlapping circles evolve into complex geometric forms, creating a mesmerising pattern that feels both organic and precise. Designed by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Platonic Energy Belt
item.description: Platonic Energy black leather belt with silver buckle, engraved with the Platonic solids. A high quality leather belt featuring the five Platonic solids woven into an evolving geometric pattern. Tetrahedrons, cubes, octahedrons, dodecahedrons and icosahedrons flow around the belt, gradually transforming into intricate geometric forms that create a sense of movement and energy. Designed by 1000 Errors.

item.title: Lost Language Leather Bracelet
item.description: Lost Language leather cuff bracelet standing on grass. A beautiful laser engraved leather bracelet featuring other worldly text only perceivable during altered states of consciousness. For wrists up to 22cm in diameter. Designed by 1000 Errors.
